headline: 人肉蜈蚣導演推遺作
context: 荷蘭導演湯姆・希克斯（Tom Six），以《人肉蜈蚣》（The Human Centipede）三部曲聞名，如今罹患多發性硬化症，推出可能是他最後一部作品。愛丁堡藝穗節（Summerhall）另有一齣改編自《哈姆雷特》的舞台劇《Ham》，以肉品產業為主題，融合喜劇與行動主義。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Now living with multiple sclerosis, Six rants about the masturbation film distributors won’t touch and the money mystery behind his horror hit Fifteen years ago, Dutch film-maker Tom Six succeeded where almost everybody fails – particularly in the world of horror. He actually shocked people. No self-respecting sophisticate admits to being shocked, of course, and no horror connoisseur will admit to being really and truly horrified. But Six really did freak audiences out with his extreme exploitation nightmare The Human Centipede, the first of a trilogy. It was a grenade in the faces of prim conformists, and also those badass horror fans who thought they’d seen it all. The “human centipede” of the title is created by a sadistic surgeon who imprisons three young people in a basement and sews them together mouth-to-anus as a vivisectional experiment. Six himself had been a director on the original Dutch TV show Big Brother that started the global franchise, and it was easy to see how his movie masterwork was intended as a satire on consumerist voyeurism and cruelty. Or maybe it just sprang from the same dark creative place that gave birth to the TV phenomenon of the age. Continue reading...
sources.title: The End of Tom Six review – Human Centipede director delivers one last freaky flick

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Summerhall, Edinburgh Vengeance for a slaughtered pig is the starting point for a riotous parody that suggests the meat industry poses an existential threat to human survival That’s my next hotdog ruined. Shakespeare’s “too solid flesh” is squeezed into a sausage-shaped form in Mary Higgins and Ell Potter’s inventively guilt-trippy new show. Leaping wildly from Hamlet, this outrageous, confrontational performance-activism layers hooting comedy with world-ending dread as Mary (a vegan) attempts to persuade Potter (nicknamed “the sausage queen” by their dad) to change their meat-eating ways. Transposing Hamlet’s existential questions to the future survival of humanity via the meat industry’s impact on the planet, Higgins takes on the role of our stubborn, sauntering prince, seeking vengeance for the ghost of a poor, slaughtered, strangely seductive pig. Suave and silly, Potter is both ghost and Gertrude, the latter reading madness into the truth only her son is brave enough to face. At Summerhall, Edinburgh, until 30 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...

thread_text:
荷蘭導演湯姆・希克斯（Tom Six），以《人肉蜈蚣》（The Human Centipede）三部曲震驚影壇，如今罹患多發性硬化症，推出可能是他最後一部作品。

愛丁堡藝穗節（Summerhall），另有一齣改編自《哈姆雷特》的舞台劇《Ham》，把莎士比亞的存在主義提問，轉移到肉品產業對地球存續的威脅，融合喜劇與行動主義。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
